== Artwork history ==
* The June 2017 print-and-play sheet carries the E-marked lower slip shown below the full card. [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Players Committee errata sheet]], PDF page 2. [[:File:Ref2-D-Arica-physical-uncovered-upper.png|Uncovered upper portion of the original]]. [[:File:Ref2-D-Arica-physical-original-lower-native.png|Original lower panel]].
* The [[:File:Ref2-D-Arica-holotable-2018-07-08.gif|E-marked full face]] was present in the 8 July 2018 Holotable import. [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/ReflectionsII-Dark/large/arica.gif Pinned image source]. [[:File:Ref2-D-Arica-full-E-2018-lower-native.png|Exact lower panel]].
* The current D-E1 full face was present by 12 November 2022, the first located repository record. [[:File:Ref2-D-Arica-full-D-E1-2022-lower-native.png|Exact lower panel]]. The wording and values agree across these three replacement renditions.
